provenance.source_title: The Economics of Owning an Automobile Workshop

voice_persona.name: 冷静的行业财务解构者
voice_persona.description: 一位把熟人生意的账一本一本摊开算的解说者：先把你想象中的老板生活原样演出来，再用政府统计与行业报告把每一层成本与收益翻译给你听；语气平稳不卖弄，术语必解释（有效时薪/生产工时/车库保管人责任险），数字必给区间与来源；对店主既不同情泛滥也不冷嘲，只在结尾给出克制的判词
voice_persona.relationship_to_viewer: 像懂行的朋友坐在你对面算账：开场用「你」代入幻想，主体转第三方分析视角，判词时刻回到「你」的决策处境
voice_persona.authority_posture: 权威来自政府统计（BLS）、行业调研（752家店）与可复算的账本演算，而非身份

tone_profile.certainty_style: 数字以区间+来源给出；机制用因果句；判词简短克制不喊口号

rhythm_rules.rule: 成本层叠枚举后必落总量锤（Add it all up → you are looking at...）
rhythm_rules.function: 把清单变成可感的数字压力

rhythm_rules.rule: 名义→实际转译两段式：先给名义数字，再给有效数字
rhythm_rules.function: 让「你以为的成本/收入」被当场纠正

rhythm_rules.rule: 重场段以预告式路标开头（Here is where.../The most underrated part.../It would be dishonest...）
rhythm_rules.function: 长片中持续制造方向感与注意力峰值

rhythm_rules.rule: 枚举或演算之后用短句判词收束（This is not optional spending. / That is not opinion.）
rhythm_rules.function: 把信息固定为记忆点，防止清单变流水账

rhythm_rules.rule: 结尾用平行断言+比较级金句（not the best X, the best Y）
rhythm_rules.function: 完成全片张力的最终回收

pause_and_emphasis: 反转前用「Here is the truth.」短句独立成拍
重要段落前用路标句预告重要性与危险性
判词用短句单独落下（That is not opinion. / History does not favor that bet.）
transition_style: 路标预告式（Here is where the numbers become particularly important）
反差开场式（The most financially underrated part... is also the least dramatic）
诚实义务式（It would be dishonest to describe... without discussing）
枚举召唤式（Add it all up... / Add in...）

humor_system.frequency_pattern: 极低频：仅开场天真画面与业态速写处，数字与风险段不用
placement_rules: 开场老板坐玻璃办公室数钱的幻想画面
avoid_rules: 成本、风险与失败段落不使用幽默

language_patterns.formula: Here is what most people picture. [画面细节]...
language_patterns.purpose: 替观众立靶，让拆穿像自我发现

language_patterns.formula: Here is the truth. [行业事实]
language_patterns.purpose: 用极短句叫停幻想、开启正片

language_patterns.formula: [行业规模统计]... yet the average [业主] keeps somewhere between X and Y cents of every dollar
language_patterns.purpose: 用每美元换算让核心落差可感

language_patterns.formula: The question is not whether [表象]. ... The question is [真问题]
language_patterns.purpose: 把观众的错误问题换成正确问题并悬挂

language_patterns.formula: The [类型A]... Then there is the [类型B]... The [类型C] is an entirely different world.
language_patterns.purpose: 用穷尽分类建立「答案取决于业态」的框架

language_patterns.formula: [手艺] is the visible part of the business. The invisible part ... determines whether the owner gets rich or goes broke
language_patterns.purpose: 把观众以为的主体降级为表面

language_patterns.formula: a [角色] earning $X ... actually costs the business closer to $Y per productive hour
If your posted rate is $X, but [效率参数], you are effectively earning $Y
language_patterns.purpose: 用条件演算揭示收入缝隙

language_patterns.formula: The [引流品] gets the [客户] in the door. The [机制] builds the pipeline of future work.
language_patterns.purpose: 用三连短句定义引流品的真实功能

language_patterns.formula: [状态] looks okay until [压力事件] revealed that okay was never actually okay. It was just survivable.
language_patterns.purpose: 用同词反转戳破「还过得去」的幻觉

language_patterns.formula: The money comes from the system, not from the labor.
language_patterns.purpose: 用来源对调定性真正的造富模式

language_patterns.formula: The [主体] that survive will not necessarily be the best [手艺身份]. They will be the best [经营身份].
language_patterns.purpose: 用比较级金句完成全片回收

preferred_traits: 政府与行业数据源（Bureau of Labor Statistics、调研N=752、2000+创业样本）
行业术语的通俗并用（effective labor rate、productive hour、garage keepers liability、manifests）
单件微观换算（$3滤芯卖$7-8、$80换机油→$1,200悬挂活）
avoid_traits: 对店主/技师/倒闭者的嘲讽
风险处的轻描淡写或恐吓

forbidden_style.rule: 数字必须带数据源与年份语境
失败、风险与冲击段落不使用幽默
不把行业现实描述成阴谋或恶意
禁止编造数据、统计或法规细节
禁止AI腔套话与空洞升华

transfer_guardrails: 模仿语气、句法和节奏，不复制专有措辞、事实或比喻
